create_tokenizer: create a Tokenizer instance from a SentencePiece model file path
encode_text: encode a string into a list of token IDs with optional bos and eos tokens
decode_tokens: decode a list of token IDs back into a human-readable string
test_tokenizer_roundtrip: test the Tokenizer encode and decode methods for roundtrip fidelity
review_tokenizer_methods: review the Tokenizer class encode and decode methods for correctness
